name: CC Hospital
source:
Ayumu falls victim to fraud and loses all of his money. He decides to work as a guinea pig for new medicines at a hospital. One day, his special constitution is found and his life changes dramatically involving doctors and nurses.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090106142926/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/cPath/146_49/products_id/1003188]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
步遭遇诈骗，失去了全部财产。他决定到医院担任新药实验对象。一天，院方发现了他的特殊体质，从此，他与医生、护士之间的生活发生了巨大变化。
